name: Yomogi Jun'ichi
source:
[spoiler]Age: 9 (at time of death)

The child of Yomogi and Utsumi. Yomogi Jun'ichi appears only in flashbacks. Outstandingly athletic and honest, he was an ideal child beloved by his family.[/spoiler]
